प्रति—नाग m. = -कुञ्जर, MBh.

m: प्रति—नायक m. ‘counter hero’, the adversary of the hero (in a play), Sāh.
an image, likeness, counterfeit, Śrīkaṇṭh.
प्रति-˚नायक See p. 662, col. 1.
प्रति-√ नी P. -नयति, to lead towards or back, AV. &c. &c.; to put into, mix, Kauś.

a: प्रतिनंद् — {c1c} P. 1 To bless; तौ गुरुर्गुरुपत्नी च प्रीत्या प्रतिननंदतुः R. 1. 57; Ms. 7. 146; Ku. 7. 87. --2 To welcome, congratulate, hail with joy, receive gladly; प्रतिनंद्य स तां पूजां Mb.; Ms. 2. 54. --3 To accept cheerfully; Ku. 3. 2. --4 To address kindly, show devotion. --Caus. To delight, gratify.

m: प्रति-√ नद् P. -नदति, to sound back, answer with a cry or shout, MBh.; R. &c.: Caus. -नादयति, to cause to resound, make resonant, fill with cries, ib.
a: प्रतिनद् — {c1c} P. 1 To resound, echo. --2 To answer with a shout. --Caus. To fill with noise, make resonant; Śānti. 2. 17; Rs. 3. 14.

m: प्रति—नदि ind. at every river, Bālar.
प्रति—नगरम् ind. in every town, Hcar.
प्रति-√ नम् (only pf. -नानाम), to bow or incline towards (acc.), RV.
प्रति—नमस्कार mfn. one who returns a salutation, ŚāṅkhŚr.

प्रति-√ नन्द् P. -नन्दति, to greet cheerfully, salute (also in return), bid welcome or farewell, address kindly, favour, befriend, AV. &c. &c.; to receive joyfully or thankfully, to accept willingly (with न, to decline, refuse, reject), Mn.; MBh. &c.: Caus. -नन्दयति, to gladden, delight, gratify, MBh.; Kām.
प्रति-˚नन्द m. N. of a poet, Cat.

s: puM, (pratiniDIyate sadfSIkrayate iti । prati + ni + DA + “upasarge DoH kiH .” 3 । 3 । 92 । iti kiH .) pratimA । ityamaraH । 2 । 10 । 36 ॥ sadfSaH । (yaTA, raGO । 1 । 81 । “sutAM tadIyAM suraBeH kftvA pratiniDiM SuciH । ArADaya sapatnIkaH prItA kAmaduGA hi sA ॥”) tasya vivecanaM yaTA । “atyantAsAmarTezu skandapurARam । ‘puttraM vA vinayopetaM BaginIM BrAtaraM taTA । ezAmaBAva evAnyaM brAhmaRaM viniyojayet ॥’ garuqapurARe । ‘BAryyA BarttfvrataM kuryyAt BAryyAyASca patistaTA । asAmarTye tayostAByAM vrataBaNgo na jAyate ॥’ varAhapurARe । ‘pitfmAtfpatiBrAtfSvaSrUgurvvAdiBUBujAm । adfzwArTamupozitvA svayaYca PalaBAgaBavet ॥’ atrEva vizaye kAtyAyanaH । ‘dakziRA nAtra karttavyA SuSrUzA vihitA ca yA .’ nanu pratiniDO mameha SarmmAdyaNgamantrasTaPalaM kutrAnveti cet praDAna eva । taTA ca SArIrikaBAzye SrutiH । ‘yAM vE kAYcanayajYaftvija ASizamASAsate yajamAnAyEva tAmASAsate iti hovAca iti .’ brAhmaRasarvvasve tu yajamAnAyetyAdO yajamAnasyEva setiM pAWe viSezaH । taTA ca saralAyAM sUtram । ‘yAM vE kAYcanayajYaftvigASizamASAste sA yajamAnasyEveti .’ ftvigyajamAnapade pratiniDipraDAnapare AkANkzitatvAditi । ataeva pratiniDiputtrAdinApyAyAntu naH pitara ityAdivadanUha eva paWyate vAkyasya kAlpanikatvAttatra na taTeti ॥ * ॥ atra pratiniDiprasaNgena smftyanusArAt kiYcilliKyate । kAlamADavIye । ‘kAmye pratiniDirnAsti nityanEmittike hi saH । kAmyezUpakramAdUrdDvamanye pratiniDiM viduH ॥’ asyArTastu mADavAcAryyeRABihitaH । yaTA nityanEmittikaM pratiniDinApyupakramya kArayet । kAmyantu svasAmarTyaM parIkzya svayameva upakramya kuryyAt । asAmarTye tu upakramAdUrdDvaM pratiniDinApi tatkArayet । etacca kAmyaM SrOtaparam । kAmyasmArttantu anyadbArApyupakramya kuryyAt । taTA ca parASaraBAzye SAtAtapaH । ‘SrOtaM karmma svayaM kuryyAdanyo'pi smArttamAcaret । aSaktO SrOtamapyanyaH kuryyAdAcAramantataH ॥’ antataH upakramAt parataH । anyaTA nityanEmittikamAtraparatve SrOtasmArttaBedenopAdAnaM vyarTaM syAttayoraviSezAdeva pratiniDilABAt । ataeva BAratapAWAdO taTA samAcAraH ॥ * ॥ smftyarTasAre । ‘nABAvasya pratiniDiraBAvAntaramizyate .’ sajAtIyamapyaBAvAntaramaBAvasya pratiniDirnezyate । BAvastu kadAcit । yaTopavAsAdObrAhmaRaBojanAdi । ‘nApi pratiniDAtavyaM nizidDaM vastu kutracit । SrotriyARAmaBojyaYca yaddravyaM tadaSezataH । grAhyaM pratiniDitvena homakAryye na kutracit ॥ dravyaM vEkalpikaM kiYcidyatra saNkalpitaM Bavet । tadalABe sadfggrAhyaM na tu vEkalpikAntaram ॥ upAtte tu pratiniDO muKyArTo laByate yadi । tatra muKyamanAdftya gORenEva samApayet ॥ saMskArARAmayogyo'pi muKya eva hi gfhyate । na tu saMskArayogyo'nyo gfhyate pratirUpakaH ॥ muKye kAryyAsamarTe tu labDe'pyetasya nAdaraH । pratirUpamupAdAya Saktamevopayujyate ॥ kAzWE rUpEstaTA parREH kzIrEH puzpEH PalEstaTA । ganDE rasEH sadfggrAhyaM sarvvAlABe paraM param ॥ grAmyARAntu BavedgrAmyamAraRyAnAmaraRyajam । yavABAve tu goDUmAstaTA veRuyavAdayaH ॥ havizye goGftaM grAhyaM tadalABe tu mAhizam । AjaM vA tadalABe tu sAkzAttElaM prayujyate ॥ tElABAve grahItavyaM tElajaM tilasamBavam ॥’ tElajaM tilasamBavaM tElaBfzwatilapizwam । ‘tadaBAve tu sasnehaM kOsumBaM sarzapodBavam ॥ vfkzasneho'Ta vA grAhyaH pUrvvABAve paraH paraH । tadaBAve gavAdInAM kramAt kzIraM viDIyate ॥ tadalABe daDi grAhyamalABe tila izyate । yatra muKyaM daDi kzIraM tatrApi tadalABataH ॥ ajAdeH kzIradaDyAdi tadalABe tu goGftam । muKyAsanno'TavA grAhyaH kAryyakAraRasantatO ॥ ataeva GftABAve pUrvvaM daDi tataH payaH ॥’ taTA । ‘sarvvatra gORakAlezu karmmacoditamAcaret । prAyaScittaM vAhftiBirhutvA karmma samAcaret ॥’ mAtsye । ‘GftaM na laByate yatra SuzkakzIreRa homayet । kzIrasya ca daDi jYeyaM maDunaSca guqo Bavet ॥’ Ayurvvede'pi । ‘maDu yatra na vidyeta tatra jIrRaguqo Bavet ॥’ pEWInasiH । ‘kARqamUlaparRapuzpaPalapraroharasaganDAdInAM sAdfSyena pratiniDiM kuryyAt । sarvvA lABe yavaH pratiniDirBavati .’ kARqaM nAlaM praroho'NkuraH । ‘sarvvAlABe yava’ iti kalpataruH ॥ avayava iti nArAyaRopADyAyAH ॥ SAntidIpikAyAM nAradIyapaYcarAtram । ‘aBAve cEva DAtUnAM haritAlaM praSasyate । bIjAnAmapyalABe tu yava eko viDIyate ॥ ozaDInAmalABe tu sahadevA praSasyate । ratnAnAmapyalABe tu muktAPalamanuttamam ॥ lOhAnAmapyalABe tu hemapAtraM prakalpayet .’ lOhAnAM tEjasamAtrARAm । nyAyaprAptapratiniDimaDikftya jEminiH । ‘na devatAgniSabdakriyARAmiti .’ asyArTaH । devatAyA agneSca AhavanIyAdeH Sabdasya mantrasya kriyAyAH prajAdyadfzwArTakarmmaRaScAdfzwamAtrArTakatvena ArAdupakArakatvAnna pratiniDiH । vrIhyAdInAntu sannipatyopakArakARAM puroqASasADanaM dfzwameva prayojanamiti tatra pratiniDirucita ityuktam .” ityekAdaSItattvam ॥ * ॥ “ArabDakArttikAdisnAne tu vyADyAdinAsAmarTye puttrAdiBiH pratiniDinA kArayitavyaM nAnukalpaviDinA nityasnAna eva tadviDAnAditi .” iti malamAsatattvam ॥ * ॥ svayaMkaraRAsAmarTye anyadbArA । yaTA, -- “dakzaH । ‘svayaM home PalaM yacca tadanyena na jAyate । ftvik puttro gururBrAtA BAgineyo'Ta viwpatiH । eBireva hutaM yattu tadDutaM svayameva hi ॥’ viwpatirjjAmAtA । evaYca ftvigAdItaratra PalanyUnatA ॥ * ॥ atrASOcASaNkayA boDanadinAt pUrvvaM SucitatkAlajIvitvarUpADikArABAve'pi yadvaraRAdikaM kriyate tat karmmakAle tasya nAradoktasvayaM pravarttanavat pravarttanAya na tu tadArnIM pratiniDIyate । aTavA । ‘niHkzipyAgniM svadArezu parikalpyartvijantaTA । pravaset kAryyavAn vipro vfTEva na ciraM vaset ॥’ iti CandogapariSizwavadanyatrApi pratiniDIyate । evaM varaRaM vinApi kvacidyadi ftvik pravarttate taTApi tatkarmmasidDiH । dakziRA ca tasmE SucikAle dAtavyeti । taTA ca nAradaH । ‘ftvik ca triviDo dfzwaH pUrvvErjuzwaH svayaMkftaH । yadfcCayA vA yaH kuryyAdArtvijyaM prItipUrvvakam ॥’ yadfcCayA svecCayA .” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥

yatra janmaDiyAM Bavet” iti । yadi ca pUrvavacanasya pUrvapakzatve vEyarTyaM syAt ata uBayavacanArTO vivakzaRIyO tadA vizayaBedena vyavasTApanIyO । taTAhi yatrAzwakASrAdDAdO kAlA ntarABAvastatra tatkAlAnuroGAdvihitadravyAlABe'pi pratinihitadravyamAdAya muKyakAla eva tatkaraRaM na tu vacanAnupAttasvecCAkalpyagO RakAlapratIkzaRam । taTAca CandogapariSizwam “sTAlIpAkaM paSusTAne kuryyAd yadyAnukalpikam । SrapayettaM savatsAyAstaruRyAgoH payasyanu” ityAdi । yatrAvdikaSrAdDAdO kfzREkAdaSyAdigORakAlo'sti tatra mftAhAdAvannAdyaBAve tadanuroDena upavAsAdirUpaM prAyaScittaM kftvA gORakAle tat krarttavyam । taTAca laGuhArItaH “ekoddizwantu karttavyaM pAkenEva sadA svayam । aBAve pAkapAtrARAM tadaha samupozaRam” । taTAca CandogapariSizwam “saMskArA atipatyeran svakAlAccet kaTaYcana । hutvEtadeva kurvIta ye tUpanayanAdaDaH” । yatra tu vinigamakavacanABAbastatra yadyapi kriyAyAH prADAnyAt kAlo dravyaM dvayamapi guRaBUtameva taTApyuBayopasaMhArAsAmarTye dravyAdaraH kAlasya sUryyAdikriyAGawitasya kartraDInatvABAvAdvarjanIyatvasidDiH asanniDikatvAnnimittatvamAtreRa bahiraNgatvAt । kAlasya nimittatvaM vyaktaM Bavizye “ataH kAlaM pravakzyAmi nimittaM karmaRAmiha” । dravyasya tu yAgasvarUpanirvAhakatvenAByarhitatvAt karmaRaH kArakatvenAntaraNgatvacca । putrAdipratiniDyaBAve tu brahmavEvarttaH “upavAsAsamarTaScedekaM viGrantu Bojayet । tAvadDanAni vA dadyAd yadBaktAddviguRaM Bavet । sahasrasammitAM devIM japedvA prARasaMyamAn । kuryyAddvAdaSasaMKyAkAn yaTASakti vrate naraH” । devIM gAyatrIm । atra cAndrAyaRAdO parisaMKyA । kASyapapaYcarAtre “macCayane madutTAne matpArSvaparivarttane । PalamUlajalAhArI hfdi SalyaM mamArpayet । atra yo dIkzitaH kaScidvEzRavo BaktitatparaH । nirnimittamadIkzAyAM na ca kzadvyADipIqitaH । annaM vA yadi BuYjIta sUlaM PalasaTApi vA । azarADamahaM tasya na kzamAmi tu kaSyapa! । kzipAmi narake Gore hfcCalyaM mama jAyate” । nimittaM prArabDacAndrAyaRAdivrataviroDa ityAdi, dIkzAyAM caruSezaprASanasya vihitatvAdadokzAyAmityuktam । kzudvyADinA pIqitaH sarvametatpradarSanamAtraM SaktO nirviroDa ityarTaH । annAdikamapyupalakzaRamiti jImUta vAhanaH । atra nimittaM prArabDacAndrAyaRAdIti yaduktaM tanna cAndrAyaRAdO BojanasyAvaSyakatvABAvAt kintu nimittaM ravivArAdyupavAsapAraRaM jalapAnarUpaM dIkzAyAmapi caruprASanaM GrARarUpam anyaTA “puroqASo'pi somo vA saMprApte harivAsare । aBakzyeRa samaH proktaH kiM punaScASanakriyA” iti nAradIyaM viruDyeta । tadGrARasya BojanarUpatAmAha kAlAdarSe SrutiH “pitramAGreyaM tannEvaM prASitaM nabati” iti pitryamupalakzaRam AkANkzAyA avaSizwatvAt । tenEkAdaSyAM taduBayorjalapAraRaM caruSezaGrARaYca kftvA upabAsaH kAryyaH” । ArabDakArttikAdisnAne tu vyADAdinA'sAmArTye putrAdiBiH pratiniDinA kArayitavyaM nAnukalpaviDinA nityasnAna eva tadviDinAditi” iti mala॰ ta॰ । svayaM karaRA'sAmarTye atyadvArA kArayitavyaM yaTA dakzaH “svayaM home PalaM yacca tadanyena na jAyate । ftvik putro gururBrAtA BAgineyo'Ta viwpatiH । eBireva hutaM yattu tadDutaM svayameva hi” viwpatirjAmAnA । evaYca ftvigAdItaratra PavanyUnatA । atrASOcASaNkayA boDanadinAt pUrvaM SucitatkAlajIvitvarUpADikArABAve'pi yadvaraRAdikaM kriyate tatkarmakAle tasya nAradoktasvayaMpravarttanavat pravarttanAya na tu tadAnIM pratiniDIyate aTa vA “niHkzipyAgniM svadArezu parikalpyartvijantaTA । pravaset kAryavAta vipro vfTEva na ciraM vaset” iti CandogapariSizwa vadanyatrApi pratiniGIyate evaM varaRaM vinApi kvacidyadi ftvik pravarttate taTApi tatkarmasidDiH । dakziRA ca tasmE SukikAle dAtavyeti taTA ca nAradaH “ftvik ca triviDo dfzwaH pUrvErjuzwaH svaryaMkftaH । yadfcCayA vA yaH kuryyAdArtvijyaM prItipUrvakam” yadfcCayA svecCayA” ti॰ ta॰ । parArTasnAne svayamaSaktO kuSamayavatimUrttisnAne'pi PalaviSezaH prA॰ ta॰ ukto yaTA “pratikftiM kuSamayIM kftvA tIrTavArizu majjayet । yamuddiSya nimajjeta so'zwaBAgaM PalaM laBet । mAtaraM pitaraM vApi BAtaraM suhfdaM gurum । yamuddiSya nimajjeta dvAdaSAMSaM PalaM laBet” । “aputreREva karttavyaH putrapratiniDiH sadA । piRqodakakriyAhetoryasmAttasmAt prayatnataH” dattakamI॰ ।
m: प्रति-˚निधि m. substitution
a substitute, representative, proxy, surety, ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a resemblance of a real form, an image, likeness, statue, picture, Kāv.
(ifc.) an image of i.e. similar, like, Kāvyād. (˚धी-√ कृ, to substitute anything [acc.] for [comp.] MBh.; Ragh.)
a: प्रतिनिधिः — 1 A representative, substitute; सोऽभवत्प्रतिनिधिर्न कर्मणा R. 11. 13, 1. 81; 4. 54; 5. 63; 9. 40. --2 A deputy, vicegerent. --3 Substitution. --4 A surety, --5 An image, likeness, picture.

k.v: प्रतिकृतिरर्चा पुंसि प्रतिनिधिरुपमोपमानं स्यात्. वाच्यलिङ्गाः समस्तुल्यः सदृक्षः सदृशः सदृक्.।

m: प्रति-˚निःसर्ग m. giving back, abandonment, Lalit. (w.r. निःसङ्ग).

प्रति-नि-√ ग्रह् Ā. -गृह्णीते, to take up (liquids), ladle out, ŚBr.
प्रति-नि-√ हन् (only 2. pers. pf. -जघन्थ), to aim a blow at (acc.), RV. i, 52, 15.
प्रति-˚निहत mfn. hit, slain, killed, MBh.

v: pratinirdeSya

tri॰ prati + nir--diSa--karmaRi Ryat । praTamanirdizwasya punarmuRAntaraviDAnArTaM buButsitArTaMpratipAdanArTaM ca nirdeSavizaye yaTA “udeti savitA tAmrastAmra evAstameti ca” atra tAmratayoditasya punastAmraguRaviSizwatayAstatvakIrttanAya punarnirdeSaH । tatra ca kaTita padatA na kAvyadozaH taduktaM kAvyagrakASe “uddeSyapratinirdeSyavyatirikto vizaya ekavadaprayIga nizeDasya, dredvati vizaye pratyuta tasyEva padasya sarvanAmno vA prayoyaM vinA dozaH । taTA hi “udeti savitA tAmrastAmra evAstameti ca । sampattO ca vipattO ca mahatAmekarUpatA” । atra rakta evAstametIti yadi kriyate tadA padAntarapratipAditaH sa evArTo'rTAntaratayeva pratiBAsamAnaH pratItiM sTagayati” । “tadvatIti uddeSya pratitirdaSyatvavatItyarTaH doza iti ApAtato'rTAntaratAvaBAsarUpa ityarTaH । ayaM BAvaH “na so'sti pratyayo loke yatra Sabdo na BAsate” iti niyamAcCabdenopasTApyamAno 'rTaH SabdaviSizwa eva BAsate ataH SabdaBedenopAdAne tacCabdaviSizwe'rTe BAsamAne viBinnaSabdarUpavizezaRaBedAdBedAvaBAsa iti । sarvanAmnApi pUrvIpAttaSabdaviSizwaBAsanAnna BedAvaBAsa ityAha sarvanAmnoveti” nAgeSaH ।
m: प्रति-˚निर्देश्य mfn. referred to or mentioned again, Sāh.
a: प्रतिनिर्देश्य — a. That which, though before expressed, is repeated in order to state something more about it; cf. the instance given in K. P. 7; उदेति सविता ताम्रस्ताम्र एवास्तमेति च, where ताम्र is repeated to show that the sun that rises red sets also red.

a: प्रतिनिर्यातनं — 1 Retribution, retaliation. --2 Returning, giving back.

प्रति-निस्-√ तॄ P. -तरति, to accomplish, Divyāv.

v: pratinyAya

avya॰ prati + ni + aya i--vA GaY । nyAyo yuktiBedI vA anakrame anatikrame vA avyayI॰ vA । 1 yaTAgataM pratyAgamane “punaH pratinyAyaM yaTA yonyA dravati” vf॰ u॰ “pratinyAyam yaTAgatam ni + Ayo nyAyaH । ayanamAyo nigamanaM punaH pUrvagamanavEparItyena yadAgamanaM sa pratinyAyaH yaTAgataM punarAgacCatItyarTaH” BAzyam । 2 yuktimanatikramyetyarTe ca ।
